nodes.label: flights CLI (Google Flights search/dates/cheapest)
nodes.rationale: Google Flights destination must be a single IATA code: multi-origin works, multi-destination does not. Prices are in USD.

nodes.label: Trip.com 5-Step Browser Booking Flow
nodes.rationale: Primary booking path because it supports ALL airlines including Wizz Air and Ryanair, via the browser skill's stealth Camoufox browser. Booking runs in a background subagent because browser work fills context fast. A ~13 minute payment timer starts on the payment page; quirks: gender is a combobox, DOB is three fields, nationality is an autocomplete.

nodes.label: Duffel API Booking (fallback)
nodes.rationale: Faster and more reliable when the airline is GDS-connected but does NOT support Wizz Air or Ryanair, hence fallback. Requires a funded Duffel balance and offers expire in ~30 minutes, so always search fresh before booking.
